content: @google-analytics/data (BetaAnalyticsDataClient) faz runReport via google-gax/grpc, pesado (~7MB unpacked, dependencia grpc). Alternativa mais leve alinhada ao padrao zero-dependencia do projeto: REST direto (POST https://analyticsdata.googleapis.com/v1beta/properties/{id}:runReport) autenticado via google-auth-library (JWT/OAuth2, sem grpc) + fetch nativo.
